description: Reviewed corrections applied by scripts/record-corpus.mjs on top of what the sources give, when it builds library.json. fields: replace a field; creators: patch the creator whose recorded lastName is the key; item: the whole item, for works with no recorded source.

eve2020.why: Crossref puts the chapter number in the title ("5. Violins in the Subway"); the book prints the title without it

fields.title: Violins in the Subway: Scarcity Correlations, Evaluative Cultures, and Disciplinary Authority in the Digital Humanities

jiang2023.why: DataCite splits the particles into the given name (given "Diego de las", family "Casas"); arXiv lists the authors as Diego de las Casas, Lélio Renard Lavaud, Teven Le Scao, William El Sayed

turingway.why: web page without DOI: entered by hand from the visible page
